name: Tor'kren Farm
summary: Tor'kren Farm is a quiet, struggling swine farm in northwestern Durotar, near Thunder Ridge and the Southfury River. Misha Tor'kren tends the homestead while anxiously awaiting news of her son Kron, who has not returned from a hunting trip.

sections.title: A Lonely Homestead
sections.body: Carving out a living from the dry, unforgiving red dirt of Durotar is never simple, but Tor'kren Farm has had a harder time than most. Situated southeast of Thunder Ridge, the homestead focuses on raising pigs in a rugged climate where feed and water are scarce. Unlike the bustling trade posts or heavily defended barracks of the Horde, the farm stands isolated and quiet, producing meager yields in the shadow of nearby bluffs.

sections.title: A Mother's Worry
sections.body: Misha Tor'kren's son Kron went west to hunt crocolisks along the Southfury River several days ago and has not returned. She had warned him about the vicious predators, but he left in anger. Now she asks passing adventurers to search for him or bring back a sign of his fate, fearing the worst but unable to begin mourning without knowing what happened.

sections.title: A Mother's Loss
sections.body: When an adventurer brings back Kron's Amulet from the river's crocolisks, Misha recognizes it and says she now knows her son is dead. Knowing his fate, she can finally begin to mourn.

faq.answer: Tor'kren Farm lies in northwestern Durotar, situated southeast of the canyon known as Thunder Ridge east of the Southfury River.
Misha Tor'kren tends the swine farm. Her son Kron is missing after setting out to hunt along the Southfury River.
Kron went hunting crocolisks along the Southfury River days ago and has not returned. Misha asks travelers to find him or bring back a sign of his fate.

aliases: what kind of farm is torkren
faq.answer: It operates as a swine farm, though harsh terrain and isolation keep its profits far leaner than other livestock operations in Durotar.

angles.text: The quiet tragedy at Tor'kren Farm reveals the everyday sacrifices made by ordinary Horde settlers striving to tame Durotar's wild frontier.
Misha's warnings about the Southfury's crocolisks remind young hunters how dangerous Durotar's riverbanks can be.
